set.body: Add explicit mapValues, coordinate-aware mapVoxels, checked zipWith, and effectful traversal where justified. Return a typed ROI result preserving source space and voxel order. Make sparse missing support policy explicit. Compose fallible stages through Either or Kleisli; do not add a lawless NeuroImage flatMap or Cats instance requiring hidden allocation evidence.
set.title: Image pipeline 2: typed functional combinators for image values and ROI data
